precisionRationale: All admitted nonzero input tokens have adjusted exponent >=-100 and <=34 significant digits; every value is an integer multiple of 1e-133. BigInt lattice conversion is exact, with finite bounded powers 0..233.

Sum, sum of squares, and N*sumSquares-sumSquared are exact BigInts. No subtraction is rounded, including cancellation yielding zero or a tiny positive dispersion. Counts <=10000000 remain exact safe integers.

Final nonzero rational division rounded to 50 significant decimal digits has relative error <=5e-50. Output exponents admitted by this finite domain remain inside Decimal minE/maxE +/-1000, including variance on the order of 1e-273 for near-identical tiny frequency data.

Decimal.js correctly rounded sqrt receives variance with <=5e-50 relative error; rounding plus propagated input error remains well below 1e-40. SD squared reconciliation uses 3e-40. This is an algorithm/error-budget rationale, not independent qualified numerical approval.
Exact canonical inputs, extrema and sum use direct integer decimal serialization without 50-digit rounding. Quantile ranks and MAD sorting use exact integer comparisons.
